purpose: Record consumer navigation to an external original while preserving source rights, correlation, privacy, and idempotency.

correlation_id.description: Correlates authorize, event receipt, and redirect

session_ref.description: Pseudonymous session reference; never cookie value

office_id.description: Brokerage related to listing when known

flow.action: WEB requests AUTHORIZE_SOURCE_NAVIGATION with listing_id, source_id, source_url and correlation_id.
D adapter validates canonical URL, current rights decision, listing-source relation, and blocked status.
When allowed, WEB emits this event before redirect; duplicate emission is accepted idempotently.
Redirect uses canonical_source_url from authorization response, never a client-supplied unvalidated URL.
When rights are FORBIDDEN, UNKNOWN, REVIEW_REQUIRED, expired, or URL relation fails, redirect is denied.

privacy_rules: Actor identity is omitted or represented by an opaque member reference outside public analytics.
Session reference is generated by Yolla and cannot contain a cookie or external platform identifier.
URL query parameters containing credentials or personal data are removed before storage.
No external authentication material is persisted in event, receipt, log, or error.

validation_cases.expected: accepted=true duplicate=true and no second event row
credential removed or request rejected before persistence
